title: Underground…city?
content: My dream world is sometimes a seemingly underground or completely indoor series of walkways that lead to areas where there are theaters, shops, bars, restaurants, an airport with a subway system to take you to your gate. The layout would be a long, broad hall, all white, random people about. Then it would open up into a huge circle with what looked like mall stores (I’d go in to all of them and check them out), then walkway then theater, which was huge and entirely full of people. I could smell the popcorn. Then another walkway to a circle of bars with balconies and multi-story patios, the one I went into looked like a cozy Asian bistro at the bottom with red patent leather booths, low ceilings, and ambient lighting. I was having the time of my life. I dream a lot of a city that I have never been to, but seems to be made up of pieces of places I have been. There is a common theme at play, I had a boyfriend that passed away suddenly. In these dreams I am always trying to find him, or I know where his house is or find out by asking around, but am too scared to face him so I stalk him like an insane person. To make this even weirder, the first time I dreamt of this world was a few weeks before he died.
